time_field_note: cnyes publication time, Taipei local, calendar day only from 2025. key_date is finlab's ingestion time in UTC and is never used for slicing (decided 2026-09-13).
dedup_key: cnyes article id parsed from url /news/id/<n>
dedup_keep: latest calendar day of date; ties broken by latest key_date
market_level_rule: an article whose stock_ids lists more than market_level_max_ids distinct tickers is market-level: kept in its own table, never in per-stock input
market_level_rationale: equals the universe size (point-in-time top 50 by market cap); fixed 2026-09-13, not a tunable parameter
stock_ids_parse: split on comma, strip, drop empty, de-duplicate
window_rule: an article belongs to the first trading session on or after its calendar date; the window for decision date T is sessions T-4..T
